# The Cunning Man

A free public grimoire of Renaissance astrology, chaos magic, and the Elder Futhark runes.
Everything is computed live in the browser; no accounts, no fees, no tracking of chart data.
For entertainment and study — not financial, medical, or legal advice.

## Instruments

- /clock — Live shield-style astrological clock: Ascendant, Regiomontanus houses, essential
  dignities (Egyptian terms), planetary hours, Moon phase and mansions, live aspectarian, and
  active transits with exact times. Recomputed every second for a chosen or geolocated place.
- /sky — Session Sky: the traditional sky across a time window you choose (up to 48 hours), for a
  chosen or geolocated place, shown in any timezone: essential dignities of the seven planets at
  the window start with any sign changes, every planetary hour and planetary day in the window,
  and the Moon's sign, phase, mansion and aspects, with its changes and quarters inside the window.
- /natal — Natal & transits: cast a natal figure (stored only in the visitor's browser) and watch
  live transits aspect it, with applying/separating state, true exact-hit dates, and verbatim
  testimony from Lilly (1647), Ptolemy, Bonatti and Ramesey.
- /synastry — Synastry meter: two birth moments weighed into one sympathy score by the classical
  doctrine of sympathy and antipathy.
- /launches — Electional scanner: the strongest hours in the next seven days to begin a venture,
  and the hours best avoided, scored by traditional rules (void of course, combustion, via
  combusta, hard applications to Saturn or Mars).
- /sigil — Chaos sigil engine: the Austin Osman Spare letter-reduction method, drawn as a
  monogram of intent.
- /runes — Elder Futhark rune cast: one lot for counsel or the three-Norn spread.
- /spells/love and /spells/money — Traditional candle workings timed by planetary day and hour,
  with the next fit hours computed live.
- /press — Press room.
- /library — Library: a study collection, not a lending library. Four historical astrology books
  the site already cites (Lilly 1647, Ptolemy trans. Ashmand 1822, Ramesey 1653, Bonatti trans.
  Coley 1676), listed by title, author and year with links to public-domain sources; no full text
  is hosted. Facets: esoteric, exoteric, market-study.
- /dignities — Dignities and Correspondences: a study reference, not a live chart and not advice.
  The essential dignities of the seven traditional planets (house, exaltation, triplicity, terms,
  faces, detriment, fall), and William Lilly's complete Book 1 signification lists for Saturn,
  Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury and the Moon (Christian Astrology, 1647), transcribed from
  the public-domain scan with page references. Sickness notes are historical study text only.

## Technical notes for agents

- All positions are real-time geocentric ecliptic longitudes (tropical zodiac), computed in the
  browser with the circular-natal-horoscope-js ephemeris. House system: Regiomontanus.
- Transits use the traditional orbs (conjunction 8, sextile 5, square 6, trine 7, opposition 8
  degrees) and classical planets only (Sun through Saturn).
- Quotes in the testimony corpus are verbatim from public-domain sources; each entry in the
  site's data file cites its verification URL.
